segments.text: Imagine a man locked in a room with only a small window.
segments.englishExplanation: Envision a man trapped inside a room that has just one small opening.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sadece küçük bir penceresi olan bir odaya kilitlenmiş bir adam hayal edin.

segments.text: Notes written in Chinese are pushed through it, and although he doesn't understand a
segments.englishExplanation: Messages written in Chinese are passed into the room, even though he cannot read them at all.
segments.turkishExplanation: İçeri Çince yazılmış notlar itiliyor ve kendisi tek bir kelime bile anlamamasına rağmen...

segments.text: single word, he follows a huge rule book that tells him which symbols to send back.
segments.englishExplanation: He adheres to a massive manual guiding him on which symbols to return in response.
segments.turkishExplanation: ...hangi sembolleri geri göndereceğini söyleyen devasa bir kural kitabını takip ediyor.

segments.englishExplanation: From the perspective of the individuals outdoors,
The responses he provides are completely accurate and flawless.

segments.text: Were they to judge by the answers alone, they would insist he speaks fluent Chinese.
segments.englishExplanation: If they were to assess him based solely on his responses, they would be convinced he speaks fluent Chinese.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sadece cevaplara bakarak karar verecek olsalardı, akıcı bir şekilde Çince konuştuğunu iddia ederlerdi.

segments.text: This is the Chinese Room, a thought experiment the philosopher John Searle proposed in
segments.englishExplanation: This scenario is known as the Chinese Room, a mental test conceived by philosopher John Searle in 1980.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu, filozof John Searle'ün 1980'de ortaya attığı bir düşünce deneyi olan Çince Odası'dır.

segments.text: 1980. His point was that following rules is not the same as understanding them.
segments.englishExplanation: He argued that merely executing instructions is fundamentally different from comprehending their meaning.
segments.turkishExplanation: Onun anlatmak istediği şey, kurallara uymanın onları anlamakla aynı şey olmadığıydı.

segments.text: Should a computer pass every test, he argued, it still might not grasp a thing.
segments.englishExplanation: Even if a machine were to succeed on all evaluations, he contended, it might still lack true comprehension.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bir bilgisayar tüm testleri geçse bile, yine de hiçbir şeyi kavramıyor olabileceğini savundu.
